gruntTasks.name: Daily Standup Data
gruntTasks.action: Pull task progress from board. Calculate velocity. Flag any tasks stuck >24h. Send standup data to Mo.

gruntTasks.name: Sprint Velocity Check
gruntTasks.action: Mid-week velocity check. Are we on track? If behind, identify what's blocking and notify Mo.

gruntTasks.name: Weekly Velocity Report
gruntTasks.action: Compile weekly velocity: tasks planned vs completed, cycle time, bottlenecks. Send to Mo.

gruntTasks.name: To-Do List Tracking
gruntTasks.action: EOS To-Do: check 7-day to-do items from last L10. Any overdue? Nudge owners. Report completion rate to Mo.

gruntTasks.name: Issues List Maintenance
gruntTasks.action: EOS Issues: review open issues list. Resolved? New ones? Prioritize for next L10 IDS session.
